## Wiring summary (who controls what)

Every element gets its own group address (`element group #0x<elementAddr>`). A load element's server models subscribe to its own group, its room group(s), the device-type group, and the element groups of buttons that were 'connected' to it. Button elements publish to their own element group or straight to a load's element group.
